title: Delete or wire up the orphaned dashboardModelProvider composition layer
why: The file's own doc comment says widgets 'previously watched 5-10 individual providers [and] now watch this one provider' (DNI-350/26.7), but dashboard_screen.dart — the only screen that could use it — still watches dashboardActiveTracksStreamProvider, dashboardUserModeProvider, dashboardStreakProvider, and activeProfileProvider directly and never references dashboardModelProvider/DashboardModel (confirmed by repo-wide grep). The only remaining consumer is the file's own acceptance test, so this 143-line composition layer is pure maintenance cost today: any leaf-provider change now has two places to stay consistent, and the second is invisible in the real UI.
recommendation: Either finish the DNI-350 migration (make dashboard_screen.dart/dashboard_body.dart consume dashboardModelProvider and delete the direct leaf-provider watches) or delete dashboard_model_provider.dart and its dedicated test.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn dashboardModelProvider lib/ returns either a real widget consumer in addition to the provider file, or zero results after deletion.
test/story_acceptance/epic_26_story_26_7_dashboard_model_provider_test.dart is updated or removed to match, not left pointing at unreachable code.
